payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the extractive models that were trained on the GameWikiSum dataset.

claims.text: Extractive models trained on the GameWikiSum dataset include LEAD-k, TextRank, LexRank, SumBasic, C_SKIP, and SemSentSum.
C_SKIP and SemSentSum are noted as near state-of-the-art models for extractive summarization.
LEAD-k serves as a strong baseline for single document summarization tasks.
